description: This Java source file defines the DittoTestSystem class, which manages the creation and shutdown of Akka ActorSystems for testing purposes. It provides a static method to run tests within isolated actor systems and includes an inner functional interface for test code consumption.

classes.name: DittoTestSystem
classes.description: Manages creation and cleanup of ActorSystem instances for testing. Implements AutoCloseable to facilitate try-with-resources management.

classes.name: TestConsumer
classes.description: A functional interface for test code to accept an instance of TestKit and perform assertions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Creates an ActorSystem based on the test object's class name, runs the provided assertions within a TestKit, and ensures cleanup of resources afterward.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem when the DittoTestSystem instance is closed.
